en.text:
Orb of Power pickups (even while the weapon is stowed) grant 1 Stack of Explosive Light. Maximum of #e${6+#d} Stacks.

Firing the weapon comsumes 1 Stack per Shot, granting increased damage and 100 Blast Radius.

Grenade Launchers: 60% increased Explosive damage.

Rocket Launchers: 25% increased Impact and Explosive damage. (Does not affect <yellow Wolfpack Rounds />)

enhanced (

#e Maximum number of Stacks is increased by 1.
